commits.subject: Merge main into mapped server service identity migration
Merge main into mapped server service identity migration

report.scope: Structural/Git verification only. No target code or tests are executed.

metadata.body:
<!--
CHANGELOG.md is generated from merged pull requests. Do not add an entry unless this PR introduces
a deprecation or breaking change.
-->

Adopts the service identities proposed in open-telemetry/semantic-conventions#4244 for Java instrumentation 3.0. Configured client-side mappings emit `server.service.name` and `server.service.namespace` without a service-identity preview flag.

Rename the flat mapping property; its value format is unchanged:
```properties
# Before
otel.instrumentation.common.peer-service-mapping=payments.example.com=payments
# After
otel.instrumentation.common.server-service-mapping=payments.example.com=payments
```

For declarative configuration, rename `java.common.service_peer_mapping` to `java.common.server_service_mapping` and each entry's `peer` field to `target`. YAML continues to support namespaces and complete targets that cannot be expressed by the flat mapping:
```yaml
java:
  common:
    server_service_mapping:
      - target: payments.example.com
        service_name: payments
        service_namespace: checkout
```

- Update backend queries from `peer.service` or `service.peer.name` to `server.service.name`, and from `service.peer.namespace` to `server.service.namespace`.
- Remove `service.peer` and `service.peer/dup` from `otel.semconv-stability.preview`. RPC preview selections remain supported.
- Old configuration names and old attribute emission modes are removed without aliases or dual emission. Unmatched requests remain unmapped.
- Couchbase no longer emits its service type as `peer.service`; those values do not identify a logical server service.

The upstream proposal is still open and the new attributes have development stability. This PR remains a draft pending upstream agreement; removing the preview gate does not stabilize the conventions.
metadata.title: Emit mapped server service identity
